text.text: A Foundry can recover extra fluids from some melting recipes. For example, the default copper ore recipe produces molten gold as a byproduct as well as molten copper.
Leave enough space in the tank: the Foundry waits for the main output to fit, but any byproduct that does not fit is lost. Recipe and yield settings may change the amounts.
Some recipes, fluid transfers and machine behavior are not yet supported or verified in this version.
